data.title: 胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸
data.description: 【胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸】海灯节万众欢腾的璃月海港观景平台上，数以万计的璀璨霄灯升入夜空。胡桃换上了华美的春风汉服罗裙，在漫天绚烂烟花绽放的瞬间欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，笑容比夜空中的花火还要灿烂夺目——「海灯节快乐！新的一年，也要记得常来往生堂坐坐哦～」
data.location: 璃月港海灯节观景平台
data.action: 身着华丽汉服在璀璨霄灯海中欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，背景漫天烟花绚烂
data.lighting: 万千金色霄灯泛光与夜空烟花多色炫彩
data.promptProse: Halfway through a light turn on the Lantern Rite viewing terrace, Hu Tao glances back over her shoulder with a broad, delighted smile. Her crimson-and-black hanfu has butterfly embroidery and flowing sleeves, one sleeve lifting gently with the motion. A jade hairpin and the familiar plum decoration catch alternating light from ascending Xiao Lanterns and a fresh burst of fireworks. The dark harbor remains visible below the luminous sky. Frame her from the knees upward at a modest low angle so the turn, sleeve and festive skyline read as one moment.
